contentSection.description: BG Elevators respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us through our website
contentSection.label: www.bgelevators.com
contentSection.description2: . This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information.
contentSection.description3: We may collect the following types of information:

items.text2: – Name, phone number, email address, company name, location, and other details you provide via contact forms.
– IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and usage data.

contentSection.description4: The information we collect is used to:

items2.text: Respond to inquiries and quotation requests
Send service-related updates or promotions (with consent)
Comply with legal and regulatory requirements

items3.description: Our website may use cookies to improve user experience and analyze website traffic. Cookies help us understand visitor behavior and enhance site performance.
You can control cookie usage through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some website features.

contentSection.description5: BG Elevators does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share information only:

items4.text: With trusted service providers assisting our operations
When required by law or legal authorities
To protect our legal rights and business interests

contentSection.description6: We use appropriate technical and organizational security measures to safeguard your personal data. However, no method of online transmission is completely secure.
contentSection.description7: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites.

items5.text: Request correction or deletion of your data

contentSection.description9: Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
contentSection.description10: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page, and continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of those changes.
contentSection.description11: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
contentSection.description15: BG Elevators is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency in how your information is handled while delivering reliable and high-quality lift solutions.
